highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.2 improves filtered-image and glyph rendering with native fixes on the existing Skia m156 engine.

bullets.lead: Keep antialiased image sampling in bounds
bullets.detail: Filtered images and Ganesh draws keep sampling within their intended image subsets and logical texture bounds under minification, strong skew, AA clipping, and MSAA. This prevents unrelated backing-texture pixels from contaminating the output when filter padding is insufficient.

Image-filter cache equality now matches its bytewise hash, distinguishing signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata consistently and avoiding floating-point-mode-dependent subnormal comparisons.

Glyph rendering uses the reloaded glyph's path when consecutive font-scaler loads disagree. Matching mask formats are required before copying, and clipped embossed glyphs preserve full plane strides, avoiding stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrupted or uncleared mask planes.
